comment: [pc] [90s] Science fiction Myst clone? the game was mostly puzzles and solving a mystery, similar to Myst. old, 90s probably. 2d graphics, probably pretty cutting edge for the time. It was a scifi game, and the most prominent thing I can remember is that there was a rather long puzzle that looked sort of like an office space, but the walls were all glass. It was a lever-maze sort of thing, where you had to pull levers to open and close certain walls. I cant recall much of anything else - I remember there was a path at the beginning that went up a hill to reach some sort of crashed spaceship, I think? Been trying to remember what it was for years. Help!
